title: Short Says Huang China Trip Would Be a Big Mistake
title_cn: Short Says Huang China Trip Would Be a Big Mistake
summary: Marc Short, former Chief of Staff to former Vice President Mike Pence, says President Donald Trump is “terrific at changing headlines” and says announcing Stephen Miller as White House Chief of Staff helped turn the page from Republicans’ midterm losses. Short says politics on both sides will make bipartisan deals difficult even where the Trump administration’s economic policies overlap with positions held by Sens. Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren. Short calls Vice President JD Vance’s post-election analysis “foolish” and says it “diminishes his role,” arguing the administration should instead focus on how it will address voters’ concerns. Short calls the revelations involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang “shocking” and says China was successful in getting the administration to change its position on export controls, adding that he expects congressional investigations. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sen. Armstrong Says Time Is of the Essence on Permitting
title_cn: Sen. Armstrong Says Time Is of the Essence on Permitting
summary: Sen. Alan Armstrong (R-OK) says permitting reform would provide a long-term, durable fix for building infrastructure and connecting lower-cost energy resources to consumers, but cautions it is not an immediate solution to affordability. Sen. Armstrong says time is of the essence to pass the bipartisan bill during the lame-duck session after years of debate. Sen. Armstrong says he is not concerned by President Donald Trump’s comment that he would not sign a permitting bill with wind turbine components because the legislation is source-neutral and does not favor wind, solar or gas. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Gimenez Says Nvidia Affair Raises Security Concerns
